name: Steinbockzentrum Tirol St. Leonhard
kurzbeschreibung: The Steinbockzentrum Tirol at Schrofenhof in St. Leonhard im Pitztal: Alpine ibex wildlife enclosure, modern architecture, and the story of resettlement.
beschreibung:
Overview

The spectacular Steinbockzentrum Tirol is located in the hamlet of Schrofen within the municipality of St. Leonhard in the inner Pitztal valley, at an altitude of approximately 1,400 metres. Officially opened in 2020, this nature and education centre is perched on a steep rocky promontory and is considered one of the most architecturally audacious excursion destinations in the Tyrolean Alps. Built directly adjacent to the historic, over 500-year-old Schrofenhof ? the oldest preserved mountain farmhouse in the entire Pitztal valley ? the centre is dedicated to the legendary animal icon of the Alps: the Alpensteinbock (Alpine ibex, Capra ibex), whose successful resettlement in the Pitztal over 70 years ago represents one of Europe's greatest species conservation achievements.

Wildlife Enclosure & Visitor Centre

The architectural ensemble harmoniously unites the heritage-listed Schrofenhof with a striking, monolithic new structure made of red-tinted concrete and local timber, hugging the mountainside like an immense boulder. In the expansive, barrier-free wildlife outdoor enclosure, visitors can observe Alpine ibexes and shy marmots up close in their natural, rocky habitat. An accessible inclined lift and wooden viewing bridges enable captivating eye-level encounters with these majestic climbing masters. Inside the modern visitor centre, an interactive multimedia exhibition depicts the thrilling history of the ibex's near-extinction and successful reintroduction to the Pitztal in 1953, the biology of the species, and the unique characteristics of high-alpine ecosystems. The historic farmhouse also houses the stylish Caf?-Restaurant am Schrofenhof, offering panoramic views of the head of the Pitztal valley.

Visit & Getting There

The Steinbockzentrum Tirol is open year-round: during the summer months (May to October) daily from 10:00 to 17:00; during the winter months (November to April) Wednesday to Sunday from 10:30 to 17:00. Admission prices (2025/2026 season): adults approx. ?9.50, seniors approx. ?8.50, children and youths (6 to 15 years) approx. ?5.00, children under 6 free; family ticket approx. ?22.00. Holders of the regional Pitztal Sommer Card enjoy free admission! Getting there by car: take the Inntal autobahn A12 to the Imst/Pitztal exit, then continue along the Pitztaler Landesstra?e L16 for about 30 km into the valley to St. Leonhard, hamlet of Schrofen (free parking right at the access driveway to the Steinbockzentrum). By public transport: take ?BB train to Imst-Pitztal station, where the Pitztaler Regiobus line 4204 connects hourly directly to the St. Leonhard Schrofen Steinbockzentrum stop.

Tips

The visitor centre, the inclined funicular lift, and the panoramic trail through the enclosure are comprehensively accessible for wheelchair users and baby strollers. Every day at 14:00, a narrated feeding session takes place in the enclosure, offering spectacular views of the powerful male ibexes with their imposing horns in full action. Traditional Tyrolean specialties from the Pitztal are served on the sun terrace of the restaurant at Schrofenhof.
